name: Operating System Control
description: Run shell commands and manage command sessions on the operating system.
progressive_guidance: Prefer dedicated tools over shell commands when they cover the task. Use file_system.file for file reads and edits and file_system.ripgrep for file discovery and content search. Read occupied destinations; patch updates without changing unrelated content. A requested output path does not authorize discarding its contents: save an exact, unique recoverable copy before full replacement, including shell writes. Resolve ordinary collisions without owner confirmation. Verify the new output and preserved bytes before completion; retain and briefly report the saved copy. If evidence is missing, verify or recover with tools.
